name: zemdomu-action
description: GitHub Action that runs ZemDomu Core semantic accessibility checks and reports pull-request annotations
author: Zacharias Eryd Berlin

scripts.build:ncc: ncc build src/index.ts --license licenses.txt -o dist && node scripts/normalize-generated-bundle.mjs dist/index.js dist/licenses.txt
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:ncc
scripts.test: npm run build && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/runner.test.mjs && node tests/run-action.test.js && node tests/multiple-h1-action.test.js && node tests/cross-component-assets-action.test.js && node tests/canonical-diagnostics-action.test.js && node tests/file-discovery-action.test.js && node tests/marketplace-metadata.test.js
